notes.title: After Release Patch
notes.notes:
Bugs Fixed after the Release:


Fixed a problem with localization texts, some texts shown as "Localized text not found" now are working properly.
Fixed a problem with some UI elements in the PlayState of the game.


UI and graphic changes:


Changed Hentai icon for a new one.
Changed challenges icons above characters.


Localization


Updated some texts to be more accurate to some gender identities and sexualities.
